protocol: Local Tesseract.js 6.0.1, tessdata_fast vie+eng, PSM AUTO, fixed manually reviewed crop and orientation. A selected phrase is recovered if best-substring normalized edit distance <=0.20. This is phrase coverage, not whole-page OCR accuracy. Native output is JPEG from original sources; Web output is PNG from common cropped decoded baseline. Codec/input differences prevent attributing Web/native OCR differences to the kernel.
scope: 10 supplied originals; no source photos or OCR transcripts included; no cloud OCR

pixelParity.webVsCppWasm: 10/10 identical RGBA outputs with common samples and illumination fields; max channel delta 0
pixelParity.nativeGolden: Four synthetic controls max channel delta <=1
pixelParity.detection: Manual crop/orientation frozen to isolate appearance; not an automatic detector qualification

limitations: Glossy cover glare and lost ink are not restored.
Image 9 phrase coverage regresses; preserve color rather than invent missing content.
Small text, formulas, diagrams, handwriting and grid patterns still need OCR-specific validation.
Desktop timings do not establish phone temperature, energy or iOS/Android compatibility.
